text:
You are not mine, you are not here
in my life,
by my side;
you do not eat at my table,
nor laugh nor sing,
nor live for me.
We are strangers,
you
and I myself
and my home.
You are a strange guest
who seeks and wants nothing
but a bed
sometimes.

What can I do?
Give it to you.

But I live alone.

translation.title: No sos mío no estás...
